title: New-service ML problem specification
description: Captured by the new-service-spec skill BEFORE scaffolding. Distinct from context.schema.json (company/project risk-context, ADR-023) and adopter_context.schema.json (infra wiring): this schema covers the ML PROBLEM definition — label, fairness attribute, cost asymmetry, data source.

label_definition.description: What the model predicts, in one sentence.

positive_class_meaning.description: What the positive class concretely means, not just '1'.

fairness_sensitive_attributes.description: Attribute(s) that must not produce disparate impact. null means explicitly confirmed none (escalates to CONSULT, never a silent default).

fairness_attribute_confirmed_none.description: Must be true if fairness_sensitive_attributes is null — records that 'none' was a deliberate, confirmed answer.

approximate_ratio.description: Rough ratio, e.g. '5:1' — an estimate is fine, null is not (use 'unknown' as a string instead of omitting).
